title: Error
description: Stage 2+ artifact: one mistake made by the user in the video, with its evidence and detection/intervention timing. Stage 1 defines the field specification only; no error candidates are produced at this stage.

step_id.description: Procedure step during which the error occurs.

error_type.description: Category from the Stage 2 error taxonomy (e.g. wrong_quantity, wrong_object, skipped_action, wrong_order, premature_action).

expected.description: What should have happened according to the instruction.

description.description: Human-readable description of the visual/transcript evidence.

evidence.description: Evidence anchoring the error in the video.

evidence_start.description: Timestamp (s) where the observable evidence of the error begins.

detectable_time.description: Earliest timestamp (s) at which a streaming agent could detect the error.

intervention_time.description: Timestamp (s) at which feedback/correction is given; null if the error is never corrected.

context_dependency.description: True if detecting the error requires earlier context (prior steps/history), not just the current frame.

required_history.description: event_ids or step_ids that must be retained in memory to detect this error; empty if frame-local.
